research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Osmind is engaged in developing a system for medical treatment recommendation and predictive modeling, as described in the title 'System for medical treatment recommendation and predictive model thereof.' The abstract details a method for adherence prediction using training and test datasets, model training across multiple trials, and validation folds. These efforts focus on leveraging data-driven approaches to support mental health treatment and research.

about_short_description.short_description: Osmind is the premier technology platform for breakthough mental health treatment and research.

product.name: Osmind 360
product.description: An integrated platform combining psychiatry-specific electronic health records (EHR), billing, and prior authorization services tailored for treatments like Spravato and TMS.

product.name: Psychiatry Electronic Health Record (EHR)
product.description: A psychiatry-focused electronic health record system with ketamine-specific charting and integrated patient app for mood tracking and validated questionnaires.

product.name: Psychiatry Billing Services
product.description: Billing and revenue cycle management services specialized for psychiatry, including prior authorizations for Spravato and TMS, credentialing, and denial management.

product.name: Psychiatry Collective
product.description: A professional community platform for psychiatric clinicians and researchers to share best practices, treatment updates, and collaborate on mental health advancements.

identifier.value: Patient App for Mood Tracking and Communication

product.name: Patient App for Mood Tracking and Communication
product.description: A patient-facing mobile application enabling mood tracking, HIPAA-compliant messaging, and electronic submission of superbills.
